description: A vitals dashboard for a Raspberry Pi 5 with an optional AI HAT+ 2: a terminal dashboard and a verb-oriented command line over the same collectors, so each readout (CPU, memory, temperatures, throttling, fan, disk, network) is also a scriptable report of one value and its unit, with JSONL recording for comparing runs.
name: rptop
releaseNotes: Pre-release scaffold: the rptop command parses its standard options and reports usage errors with the workspace exit codes.
